description: The three enemy teams you can fight right now in the Fosse, as compositions only (name/type/preset/rarity/level — never stats), plus your team (with ids and progression: xp, xp_next = level×100), the bet table (bronze 5 / silver 12 / gold 25 FA), payout_mult (1.7), free_fights_remaining and daily caps. Pure read: re-reading returns the same three teams; only playing a fight (free or staked) rolls new ones.
